triage.summary: Marina Sokolova, managing partner of a law firm, was referred by Pavel Gusev and wants a Russian-language document-search assistant for about 5,000 contracts. She asks for a call on Thursday, October 15, or Friday, October 16, after 15:00.

task.title: Reply to Marina Sokolova about a discovery call
task.description: Marina Sokolova (marina@sokolova-law.ru), managing partner of a law firm referred by Pavel Gusev, wants an assistant for searching about 5,000 contracts using questions in Russian. Reply with your availability for a call on Thursday, October 15, or Friday, October 16, after 15:00.

reply.body:
Марина, здравствуйте!

Спасибо за обращение! Буду рад обсудить поиск по вашей базе из примерно 5 000 договоров на русском языке.

Для созвона мне подходит [день и время после 15:00]. В каком часовом поясе вы указали время?

С уважением,
Алекс
